searchText: hello I want to check an information, is the validator penalty rate when it is absent or inactive in the network is (basic reward *3) per era Why is the balance of a slashed validator decreased immediately on `slash_validator()`? What invariant security property would be lost if the balance was only reduced on `process_slashings()` Why is a slashed validator not allowed to withdraw until `EPOCHS_PER_SLASHINGS_VECTOR` if correlated penalties (`process_slashings`) are applied on `EPOCHS_PER_SLASHINGS_VECTOR // 2`? For the latter: there may be more technical reasons, but definitely it's good to have extra slack to have time on social slashing
